config.workload: Exploratory, NOT feature-equivalent: same real desktop corpus from port commit 521c0918a, isolated fresh XDG profiles, bubblewrap read-only host and private home/network; Xvfb :2 1280x800x24 no WM; both UI processes started; no TS extensions; upstream file/index/input/calculator services exist but port equivalents absent. Rust serve --no-hotkey plus resident UI. Official upstream --no-extension-runtime --open. Shared X server excluded. CPU governor not controlled; shared development host. This establishes ping interoperability and raw process footprint, not cutover performance.
